episodes.title: Paul Mackenzie | The Cult Leader Masked as a Preacher
episodes.description:
Over 400 human beings—more than half of them children—were found buried in shallow graves in Kenya's Shakahola forest. They didn't die from natural disasters or war. They were starved to death by a charismatic preacher they trusted implicitly.

This video goes beyond the gruesome headlines to explore one of the most disturbing questions about the human mind: How does an ordinary person—a mother, a father, a schoolteacher—reach a point where they willingly walk into a forest and watch their own children starve to death in the name of God?

From the unremarkable rise of taxi driver Paul Nthenge Mackenzie to the horrific "Starvation Protocol" enforced by his armed militia, we trace the precise steps Mackenzie used to cut every thread connecting his followers to reality.
